glossary_additions.source: Target 183:t_114:4 and seven other corpus occurrences of Ichi-niichan identify Kappei's older brother Ichitaro. Existing glossary spells Ichitaro; https://www.mahq.net/zambot3ep1/ corroborates the relationship. Ichi is a source-faithful shortened form, not a verified licensed English nickname.
glossary_additions.note: Use Big Bro $$イチ$$ for Kappei's address. No new numeric character binding. Whole-corpus scan found eight records with this nickname.

glossary_additions.source: Target 188:t_1:65 uses the emigrant fleet's short name. Existing glossary Frontier fleet and Macross Frontier fleet use the same spelling; https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/Macross_Frontier_(Spacecraft) identifies the Frontier Fleet. Retain source short form; do not expand it or confuse it with Battle Frontier/Queen Frontier.
glossary_additions.note: Whole-corpus substring scan found 50 source records, including longer compounds. New short-form token only; no global substitutions or numeric binding.

glossary_additions.source: Target 93:t_2:6 explicitly locates Nono's upbringing in the Marineris canyon on Mars; 177:t_1:449 repeats it. https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/valles-marineris-grand-canyon-of-mars/ establishes the geographical English name Valles Marineris. Applying that name to this fictional setting is source-based inference, not a verified licensed subtitle.
glossary_additions.note: Three source records contain the exact term. Standardize the fresh batch's literal Marineris Valley references through this token.

glossary_additions.source: Ten source records use Rand's named smile, including 87:t_2:39, 177:t_1:554 and 177:t_1:601. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/ランド・トラビス confirms the named thumbs-up/wink gesture; https://blog.spalog.jp/?p=5962 uses the Japanese label officially. English is a transparent rendering of the loanword name.
glossary_additions.note: Tokenize the named gesture consistently; keep ordinary descriptions of a smile as prose.

glossary_additions.source: Target 81:t_1:84 invokes Newton, falling apples and gravity; one source occurrence. The Newton Project's scholarly edition of Stukeley's memoir corroborates the allusion and surname: https://www.newtonproject.ox.ac.uk/view/texts/normalized/OTHE00001 . This is a real-world reference, not a new pilot binding.

Target 87:t_10:16; one source occurrence. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/AG confirms all three absurd weapon suggestions and their earlier Z-series callback. Preserve the exaggerated calibre; descriptive English rather than a verified localized weapon label.
Target 87:t_10:16; one source occurrence. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/AG confirms exact Japanese weapon label in the callback joke. Transparent loanword rendering; no licensed English found.

Target 87:t_10:16; one source occurrence. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/AG confirms exact Japanese name. Retain the proposed romanization and flag it for review; do not silently substitute the different Zankantou weapon. No established English form located.

Target 194:t_1:118; one corpus occurrence. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/リン・ミンメイ describes the Zentradi culture-shock phenomenon; existing glossary spells Minmay. Preserve the source's Shock term rather than substituting the distinct Minmay Attack label. English composite is a project proposal.

Five corpus occurrences; target 194:t_1:76 pairs Ranka's epithet with Sheryl's Galactic Fairy. https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/Ranka_Lee identifies the epithet and uses Super-Dimensional Cinderella in the Bobby description alongside Super-Dimension/Super Dimension variants. Retain the translator's supported adjective form consistently.
glossary_additions.note: Title only, not a new character ID or speaker token.

glossary_additions.source: Two source occurrences: 777:t_1:15 and 777:t_1:42. Existing glossary ウルズ spells Urzu; https://fullmetalpanic.fandom.com/wiki/Special_Response_Team uses Urzu for the SRT callsigns and https://fullmetalpanic.fandom.com/wiki/Soviet_Union uses Urzu Team. Other pages vary to Uruz; retain the established glossary form. No numeric binding.

One target occurrence, 194:t_1:233 (western Oceania front). Standard regional spelling confirmed by United Nations M49: https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/M49 . Direction and front remain ordinary prose.

Three corpus records: 194:t_2:8, 230:t_1:29, 753:t_021:0. https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/Fold_Quartz maps the exact Japanese term and describes the crystal used in the Nome family heirloom. Wiki-sourced status, not a claim of a licensed game localization.

One target occurrence, 194:t_3:9, plural mecha carried back to the New World Continent. https://gurrenlagann.fandom.com/wiki/Gunmen gives Gunmen as the mecha class name. Wiki-sourced status; no numeric robot binding.

One source occurrence of this exact full spelling, 206:t_1:265. https://fullmetalpanic.fandom.com/wiki/Arm_Slave confirms the class name and AS abbreviation. Generic mecha class term, not a specific robot ID. Keep AS abbreviations as written elsewhere.

One corpus occurrence, 219:t_013:0, the source's bare model number. https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/VF-27%CE%B2_Lucifer documents VF-27; existing glossary contains full Lucifer mode names. Keep the short spoken number without adding a model suffix or mode. No new numeric robot binding.

One corpus occurrence, 195:t_026:2. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/タカヤノリコ identifies Okinawa Girls' space school and its Okijo abbreviation; https://gunbuster.fandom.com/wiki/Okinawa_High_School_for_Girls confirms the school. Keep a short English school name to reflect the familiar abbreviation; project rendering, not an official English nickname.
glossary_additions.note: The school noun is implicit in the short name; avoid adding another possessive suffix to the token.

glossary_additions.source: Target 224:t_3:80 is Alto's short model reference. Existing full Messiah mode names use VF-25; https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/VF-27%CE%B2_Lucifer explicitly contrasts VF-27 with VF-25 Messiah. Retain the source's bare model number without suffix or mode; no numeric binding.

Target 225:t_014:4 uses the short drone name; whole-corpus substring scan found five records including longer compounds. https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/AIF-9V_(V-9)_Ghost confirms Ghost; existing glossary has Ghost V9. Keep source short form; plural s stays outside the token. No numeric binding.

Target 224:t_1:75 and 224:t_1:83 shorten the linked Evil series term in 224:t_1:74. Five corpus substring occurrences including full compounds. https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/Protoculture names the super-Zentradi Evil, while https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/Protodeviln describes their possession. Proper entity/class name, not the ordinary moral adjective.
